_comment: Shared cross-language fixture for the knowledge-graph generator. The vitest suite (src/generators/parity.test.ts) runs `build(input)` and the pytest suite (python/generators/test_viewer_generators.py) runs `knowledge_graph_build(input)`. BOTH must emit `expectedView` exactly. One file, two readers — the TS and Python generators cannot drift. source.value is compact JSON with fixed key order so the serialized strings are byte-identical across languages.
